Xromi (hydroxyurea) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-241268  
Guideline Name 
Xromi (hydroxyurea)  
Formulary 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Xromi  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of sickle cell anemia  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 2082 ---
Page 2082 
 
2 - Patient has moderate to severe painful crises  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is 6 months of age or older  
 
AND 
 
4 - One of the following:  
 
 4.1 Patient is unable to swallow solid oral dosage forms (e.g., oral tablet, capsule) due to one 
of the following:  
Age  
Physical impairment (e.g., difficulties with motor or oral coordination)  
Dysphagia  
Patient is using a feeding tube or nasal gastric tube  
 
OR 
 
 4.2 Dosage requirements cannot be met with a solid dosage form  
Notes  
Note: PA is required for patients greater than 10 years of age 
 
Product Name:Xromi  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy  
Notes  
Note: PA is required for patients greater than 10 years of age
